memories: 從來不叫我名字的導師
memories_en: the banyan tree at the end of the corridor
the teacher who never said my name
the exam ranking pinned on the wall

pa.en: Student on duty, please come to the teachers' office now.
pa.zh: 值日生請現在到教職員辦公室一趟。

cards.title: 榕樹的根堵住走廊盡頭
cards.title_en: banyan tree roots block corridor end
cards.whisper_en: the roots hang lower than yesterday

edits.corridor: Make the middle ceiling fluorescent tube dark, make the far corridor beyond it far too long with the brown doors on the right all standing ajar repeating into the distance, move the red bucket with mop to stand alone in the middle of the floor by the green railing with a wet mop trail running up the right wall, and hang a few thin banyan aerial roots a little lower over the far end plus one large thin root hanging in the foreground by the sinks and taps.
edits.door: Make the top ceiling fluorescent tube dark, leave the large wooden sliding door and the farther wooden doors all standing ajar repeating into the distance, place the small red bucket on top of the wooden shoe cabinet with white sneakers where it could not be, and hang large thin banyan aerial roots down in the foreground from the ceiling draped over the shoe cabinet and over the bulletin board with blank papers.
edits.office: Add large thin banyan aerial roots hanging down in the foreground from the ceiling of the teachers' office, with one long white fluorescent tube dark above them.

cards.title: 導師的門貼滿空白卡片
cards.whisper: 他從沒叫過你的名字，卻留給你這麼多張。
cards.title_en: teacher's door covered in blank cards
cards.whisper_en: he never said your name, but he left you many.

edits.corridor: Make the nearest long white fluorescent tube dark, stretch the corridor beyond it far too long toward the green railing and banyan tree at the end, leave every brown wooden door on the right standing ajar, move the red bucket with the mop from beside the stone sinks and taps to standing alone in the middle of the distant wet floor, run a dark wet mop trail from the floor up the right wall, and plaster the nearest brown wooden doors in the right foreground with many large blank white name cards o
edits.door: Keep the large wooden sliding door with its small window half-open with bright white light inside, stretch the left corridor with its wet floor and fluorescent tubes far too long with the same wooden doors repeating into the distance, and cover the whole wooden sliding door in the foreground with many large overlapping blank white name cards, one slipped half out, clearly visible above the wooden shoe cabinet full of white sneakers and beside the cork board with blank slips.
edits.office: Add in the first photo a foreground office wooden door completely covered edge to edge with many large overlapping blank white name cards, one blank card slipped half out of its holder beside the door, lit by cold white fluorescent tubes.

cards.title: 排名條貼滿教室的牆
cards.whisper_en: your rank is still pinned here.

edits.corridor: Make the farthest white tube light dark, stretch the corridor beyond the green railing far too long, leave every wooden door on the right standing ajar, move the red bucket with the mop from beside the sinks to stand alone in the middle of the wet floor far down the corridor, run a dark mop trail from the floor up the left wall beside the concrete sinks, and plaster many large blank white ranking slips with no text all across the sink backsplash and the barred windows in the foreground, one hang
edits.door: Dim one overhead tube light, repeat the same wooden sliding door with small window receding into the distance down the wet corridor on the left with every door left ajar, and cover the cork bulletin board beside the sliding door edge-to-edge with many large overlapping blank white ranking slips with no text filling the frame, one blank slip hanging crooked with its pin lying on the wet floor below, keep the wooden shoe rack with white sneakers prominent in the foreground.
edits.office: For the first teachers' office photo, cover an entire wall and desk surfaces with many large blank white ranking slips with no text, layered and overlapping and filling the room, one blank slip hanging crooked with its pin lying on the floor below.

cards.title: 樹根封住了走廊盡頭
cards.whisper: 根長回來了，把出口堵住。
cards.title_en: tree roots close the corridor end
cards.whisper_en: the roots grew back to shut the way out

edits.corridor: Cover the far open end above the green metal railing with a dense curtain of thick tangled brown aerial roots hanging down to almost close the corridor, and drape several more very large thick aerial roots down in the extreme foreground from the ceiling and fluorescent tubes over the long stone sinks and the barred windows so they dominate the left side of the photo.
edits.door: Hang a dense mass of thick tangled aerial roots down large in the foreground from the ceiling over the brown sliding door with blank papers and over the wooden shoe rack full of white sneakers, with more thick roots pushing in through the bright open doorway to almost block it.
edits.classroom: Turn every small wooden chair around to face the camera around the wooden desks, and hang large thick tangled aerial roots down from the ceiling into the foreground over the nearest desks plus a dense curtain of thick roots hanging across the open rear doorway under the TV and across the open side window by the rice cooker, filling the room.

cards.title: 導師的空白卡片鋪滿地板
cards.whisper: 名字都不見了，只剩空白。
cards.title_en: teacher's blank cards cover the floor
cards.whisper_en: every name is gone, only blank stays

edits.corridor: Cover every brown wooden door on the right wall with overlapping blank white cards to match the nearest door filling the right foreground, hang a plain white short-sleeved school shirt on each barred window grille on the left, and place a single curled blank card on the wet reflective floor below the nearest covered door.
edits.door: Cover the entire brown sliding wooden door from floor to its small window with overlapping blank white cards, leave the small wall holder beside the door empty, and place one curled blank card on the wet floor beside the pair of white sneakers in front of the wooden shoe rack.
edits.classroom: Push every wooden desk away to leave one wooden desk alone in the foreground with all wooden chairs turned to face the camera, lay one blank white card flat on top of every wooden desk, and drape a plain white short-sleeved school shirt over the back of every chair.

cards.title: 排名牆一片空白，紙角捲起
cards.whisper: 所有名字都消失了，只剩空白。
cards.title_en: ranking wall hangs blank and curling
cards.whisper_en: every name is gone, only blank stays.

edits.corridor: Cover the right-side brown doors and pale wall in the near foreground with dozens of large blank white ranking slips, curling loose and overlapping to fill the frame, with more blank slips scattered across the wet terrazzo floor in the foreground.
edits.door: Make the many blank papers on the open wooden sliding door curl and hang loose with several missing, strip the cork notice board beside the double wooden doors so its blank sheets curl loose with pins missing, and scatter large blank ranking slips in the foreground around the white sneakers and wooden shoe rack.
edits.classroom: Stack tall piles of blank white exam papers from floor to ceiling on the wooden desks in the foreground and middle, turn every wooden chair to face the camera, leave many blank slips curling loose along the green blackboard tray and pigeonhole shelves, and cast long shadows of a whole class of desks and chairs across the wet floor with nobody casting them.

memories: 從來不叫我名字的導師
memories_en: the banyan tree at the end of the corridor
the teacher who never said my name
the exam ranking pinned on the wall
changes: 導師的門貼滿空白卡片
changes_en: teacher's door covered in blank cards
tree roots close the corridor end
ending.comment: 我終於知道你在榕樹下等得多安靜。牆上的榜單，原諒我。你從來不只是一個名次，我現在看見你了。
ending.comment_en: I finally learned how quietly you waited by the banyan. Forgive the list on the wall. You were always more than a rank — I see you now.
